retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered ensemble cast composition featuring a central typographic lockup with integrated graphic elements like scissors and heavy outlines.
triggerTerms: layered group portrait with large title

recipe.visualDefinition: A crowded, brightly lit group portrait of diverse characters standing in front of a storefront, anchored by a large, stylized title treatment in the lower third that uses heavy strokes and integrated iconography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale title lockup as the primary visual anchor
Warm, daylight exterior lighting contrasting with dark outlines
Diagonal character placement leading the eye to the center
coreInvariants: Heavy black and white double-outlining on display text
Integrated graphic device (scissors) within the typography
Ensemble cast arranged in a shallow depth-of-field street setting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body and three-quarter length figures arranged in a staggered V-formation, filling the entire frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, gold-filled title lockup positioned in the lower third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the prominent figures on the right and left edges toward the central characters and down to the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures and architectural background elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones and denim blues in character clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright blue sky and white highlights in the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and yellow used for the primary title fill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with clear, bright values to maintain a comedic, upbeat tone.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick black outer strokes and thinner white inner strokes
The letter 'S' or 'R' often extends into a graphic flourish
Secondary text is tightly tracked and capitalized
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' or 'P' tail is modified to resemble a pair of barber shears
Numbers are scaled larger than the preceding text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy decorative slab serif paired with a clean, functional condensed sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Barber shears integrated into the baseline
Parental advisory style box in the corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight for the main title.
Suitable for the condensed, high-impact subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of 8-10 diverse people in casual urban attire standing in front of a sunny storefront with a blue sky background. Leave the bottom third clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large gold-gradient title with a thick black and white double outline. Integrate a vector graphic of scissors into the tail of one of the letters. Add a smaller condensed white subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Are the scissors integrated into the text?
Is the cast arranged in a layered, staggered formation?
Is the color palette dominated by gold, blue, and earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Graphic icon type (e.g., comb instead of scissors)
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the busy background.
Ensure the double outline is consistent across all letters.
Verify the scissor graphic is stylistically unified with the font.
Confirm the lighting on the characters matches the outdoor setting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast + Storefront background + Double-outlined slab-serif title + Integrated tool icon = Urban Comedy Poster Aesthetic
